description:
Location: crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/filenode.rs:881-885 (handle_filenode_copy state guard).

The handler currently reads only `ifInState` (the DESTINATION-account state
guard) at line 881. RFC 8620 §5.4 defines a second, equally mandatory
state guard for `Foo/copy`:

> ifFromInState: "String|null"
> This is a state string as returned by the "Foo/get" method. If
> supplied, the string must match the current state of the account
> referenced by the fromAccountId when reading the data to be copied;
> otherwise, the method will be aborted and a "stateMismatch" error
> returned. If null, the data will be read from the current state.

The current handler never calls `get_state(from_account_id)` to compare
against an `ifFromInState` argument from the request. The arg is
silently dropped: a client that sends `ifFromInState: "S12"` to ensure
the source data has not mutated since their last read gets a copy
performed against whatever the current source-account state is, with
no error signal.

Concrete failure mode: client A reads source records at state "S12",
then re-issues `FileNode/copy` with `ifFromInState: "S12"` to ensure
the copy reflects the data they saw. Meanwhile client B has mutated
the source records (state now "S13"). The handler ignores
`ifFromInState`, performs the copy from current state "S13", and
returns success. Client A receives a copy that does not match the
data they intended to clone — a silent read-your-writes violation.

Required fix: after parsing `from_account_id`, fetch the source
account's state, compare against `ifFromInState` if present, and
return `JmapError::state_mismatch()` (which RFC 8620 §5.4 maps to
the `stateMismatch` error type) on mismatch. The check must run
BEFORE the existence/auth checks complete to satisfy the "abort the
method" semantics.

Note: per the AGENTS.md "Caller identity (foundation seam)" section,
the from-side state check must be authorised against `caller`'s
read access on `from_account_id` — the backend's `get_state` is the
canonical authorisation point. Handler-side state-only check is
fine; the backend will reject the read if the caller cannot see the
account.

LABELS: api-contract, underspecified, spec
title: handle_filenode_copy ignores ifFromInState (RFC 8620 §5.4 source-state guard)
